flow.title: // how my agents work · click a step or run it

steps.label: Event
steps.text: WhatsApp message, webhook or scheduled task
steps.detail: It can be a WhatsApp message, a webhook or a scheduled task. It comes in through n8n or custom code.

steps.label: LLM
steps.text: Claude, OpenAI or DeepSeek reason and pick a tool
steps.detail: The model interprets the intent and decides which tool to use (tool use). I use Claude, OpenAI or DeepSeek depending on the case.

steps.label: API
steps.text: Odoo, Mercado Libre, Tienda Nube and REST services
steps.detail: It reads from or writes to Odoo, Mercado Libre, Tienda Nube or other REST services.

steps.label: Action
steps.text: Replies, quotes, updates or closes the sale
steps.detail: It replies to the customer, builds the quote, updates the record or closes the sale.

p: I come from operations: I coordinated teams, audits and processes before moving on to automate them. That background helps me understand the business problem before choosing the tool.
Today I work with LLMs, n8n, Power Automate and Python/JavaScript, and I study Industrial Engineering at UADE. I like to launch fast with what already exists and build custom only what is needed.
now: Developing automations and AI solutions at Softtek
Building my second brain with Obsidian, MCP and Claude
Studying Industrial Engineering and a SAP diploma at UADE
